Name: More Lively Quarry Map Overhaul
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][center]Gives Mountain Quarry area more lively and natural look. Included ability to plant crops and fruit trees, added small custom shed where you can place casks or other machines.[/center]
[center][i]This mod  inspired by Lnh's additional area mods,  [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91684178?tab=user+files]check them out[/url] if you want! [/i][/center]

[b][u][color=#ffe599]Features:[/color][/u][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]More natural looking quarry map[/size]
[*][size=3]Vanilla river bank instead of dry dirt[/size]
[*][size=3]Less unpassable rock clutter[/size]
[*][size=3]Abitily to plant crops and fruit trees[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom small shed where you can place casks or other machines[/size]
[/list][size=3][size=3][b][u][color=#ffe599]Config:[/color][/u][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Mod enabled - on/off[/size]
[*][size=3]Allow Planting Crops - on/off[/size]
[*][size=3]Vanilla River - Dry/Water[/size]
[*][size=3]Shed in quarry - off/on[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][color=#ffe599]Installation:[/color][/u][/b]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install all the required mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Put "Aimon's More Lively Quarry Overhaul" folder from mod's archive into your main "Mods" folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]NOTE: ﻿For stardew 1.5.6 you'll also need Extra Map Layers and Custom Decoration Areas mods
[/size][size=3]
[b][u][color=#ffe599]Compability:[/color]
[/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with any recolor[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with Stardew Valley Expanded[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with East Scarp, but you'll need to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21559]this modfix [/url]made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83651033]VulbyAlt[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with Raffadax mods (note that the quarry trader will sit in the middle of the path to shed but you can walk through it (see the screenshots)[/size]
[*][b][b][color=#ffe599]Probably Compatible[/color][/b][/b] with Ridgeside Village and East Scarpe (haven't tested in 1.6 stardew)
[*][size=3][b][b][color=#ffe599]Probably Compatible[/color][/b][/b] with Stardew Valley Reimagined 2[/size]
[*][size=3][b][b][color=#ffe599]Probably Compatible[/color][/b][/b] with Stardew Valley Reimagined 3  (but my mod will only add shed into SVR3 quarry (if shed is enabled)[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#e06666]Not compatible[/color][/b] with any other mods that change Quarry appearance[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b][u][color=#ffe599]Issues:[/color][/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]This mod is safe to install on already existing save file[/size]
[*][b][size=3][u][color=#e06666]Warning![/color] [/u]If you decide to deinstall this mod, don't forget to pick up all your stuff from custom shed (if you won't it will be lost forever after deinstalling the mod).[/size][/b][size=2][u][/u][/size]
[/list][size=2][b][center]<------------------------->[/center][/b][/size][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=3][center][/center][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[b][u]
[color=#ffe599][size=3]Mods used on screenshots:[/size][/color][/u][/b][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Gwen's Medieval Buildings[/size]
[*][size=3]Foliage Redone[/size]
[*][size=3]Simple Foliage[/size]
[*][size=3]Better Water 2[/size]
[*][size=3]Wildflower Grass Field[/size]
[*][size=3]Seasonal Clover Dig Spot[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size]
